name: Ohio State Wexner Medical Center K-12 health care career exploration
org: The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center
what_you_do: Schools can book health care career experiences: classroom talks, phone calls with experts, and field trips. Schools with a partnership agreement can also set up shadowing and internships in fields like nursing, imaging, lab work and research.
who_can_apply: K-12 schools ask for these experiences, not students or parents. Central Ohio schools and schools with a Workforce Partnerships agreement come first. Internships need a recommendation from a school district staff member.
pay_detail: No cost or pay is stated on the page.
duration: Varies; shadowing is a one-time visit and internships repeat
deadline_text: Student experiences run during the school year only. Schools should send requests at least 60 days ahead.
how_to_apply: Ask your school counselor or career teacher to fill out the request form on the page. The medical center asks that parents and students do not send requests for their school. New Workforce Partnerships agreements are full right now.
notes: Ohio State's hospital volunteer programs are only for people 18 and older, so this school route is the way in for high schoolers. Internship fields listed: respiratory therapy, clinical laboratory, imaging, nursing, rehab and sports medicine, and research.
